dedupe_keys.name: a fine resolution dataset of accessibility under different traffic conditions in european cities

description: A fine resolution dataset of accessibility under different traffic conditions in European cities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Aris Christodoulou et al. Urban accessibility and congestion indicators allow us to benchmark cities. If these indicators are also available at a fine resolution, we can compare different neighbourhoods within a city. We present a dataset of different accessibility indicators for all urban areas with more than 250 thousand people in the EU27, the UK, Switzerland and Norway. Coverage: several countries (GB, CH, NO); published in 2020. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
